title: Verified-report workflow accepts governance-only validation without the strict runtime-evidence gate
title_de: Verified-Report-Workflow akzeptiert Governance-only-Validierung ohne striktes Runtime-Evidence-Gate
summary: A workflow named as verified report governance invoked only the governance-only report-layout target. It could succeed while the strict runtime-evidence gate failed, so report governance alone could be mistaken for verified runtime evidence.
summary_de: Ein als Verified-Report-Governance bezeichneter Workflow rief nur das Governance-only-Report-Layout-Target auf. Er konnte erfolgreich sein, während das strikte Runtime-Evidence-Gate fehlschlug; dadurch konnte Report-Governance allein mit verifizierter Runtime-Evidence verwechselt werden.
observed_behavior: At Parent revision c8ca0d92b630c18232b881855c4f5d1482568ea6, workflow lines 41-44 invoked `make report-governance`, which invokes `--governance-only`. The governance target returned success while the strict evidence checker returned a nonzero result for stale or missing runtime evidence inputs.
observed_behavior_de: Auf Parent-Revision c8ca0d92b630c18232b881855c4f5d1482568ea6 riefen die Workflow-Zeilen 41-44 `make report-governance` auf, das `--governance-only` verwendet. Das Governance-Target war erfolgreich, während der strikte Evidence-Checker für veraltete oder fehlende Runtime-Evidence-Inputs nicht erfolgreich war.
expected_behavior: A workflow that represents verified report evidence must execute the strict runtime-evidence gate after its governance checks. Governance-only validation remains non-evidence validation and cannot mint a runtime-evidence claim.
expected_behavior_de: Ein Workflow, der verifizierte Report-Evidence repräsentiert, muss nach seinen Governance-Checks das strikte Runtime-Evidence-Gate ausführen. Governance-only-Validierung bleibt Non-Evidence-Validierung und kann keinen Runtime-Evidence-Claim erzeugen.
impact: A stale, incomplete, or absent runtime-manifest set could be hidden behind a successful governance-only check, undermining release evidence and report integrity.
impact_de: Ein veralteter, unvollständiger oder fehlender Runtime-Manifest-Satz konnte hinter einem erfolgreichen Governance-only-Check verborgen werden und damit Release-Evidence und Report-Integrität untergraben.
preconditions: The verified-report workflow is run against reports whose layout is valid.
Strict runtime evidence is stale, incomplete, or otherwise rejected.
reproduction: Run `make report-governance` with the documented external task roots and observe success.
Run the strict report-evidence checker against the same checkout and observe rejection of stale or missing runtime evidence.
Before the remediation, run the focused workflow-contract test that requires `make verified-report-evidence-gate` and observe failure.

evidence.command: rtk make report-governance; strict checker command retained in the validation report

root_cause: The workflow wired a governance-only target but omitted the existing strict runtime-evidence target. The two targets enforce different trust boundaries.
root_cause_de: Der Workflow verdrahtete ein Governance-only-Target, ließ aber das vorhandene strikte Runtime-Evidence-Target aus. Die beiden Targets erzwingen unterschiedliche Trust Boundaries.
proposed_remediation: Add the existing strict target to the verified workflow, retain governance as a companion check, and cover the workflow ordering and both target names with a focused test. Do not regenerate reports or weaken the strict checker.
proposed_remediation_de: Das vorhandene strikte Target zum Verified-Workflow hinzufügen, Governance als Begleitcheck beibehalten und Workflow-Reihenfolge sowie beide Target-Namen mit einem fokussierten Test abdecken. Keine Reports regenerieren und den strikten Checker nicht abschwächen.
acceptance_criteria: The verified-report workflow invokes `make verified-report-evidence-gate` after `make report-governance`.
A report without accepted runtime manifests cannot produce a successful verified-evidence workflow result.
A legitimate complete, checksum-consistent runtime-evidence run remains eligible for verification.
No report file is hand-edited to make the strict gate pass.
validation_plan: Run the pre-fix workflow-contract test and retain its failure.
Run the same test after the workflow change, plus YAML/static workflow validation when available.
Run report-governance and the strict gate separately to preserve the distinction between governance and runtime evidence.
Obtain PR CI, CodeQL, SonarQube Cloud, and exact-head evidence before setting verified.
regression_tests: Focused report-evidence gate tests for absent runtime manifests and inconsistent checksums.
legitimate_control_tests: A complete current run with consistent manifests and checksums passes the strict gate.
Governance-only layout checks remain available but are not presented as runtime verification.
dependencies: FND-CROSS-0001 must be reconciled before a currently stale repository can become release-verified.
residual_risk: PR 55 exact head 42b31f1c84c0c915a5cb65119714613fbf3e0c40 has the strict gate and passed CodeQL/SonarCloud, but its correct report-governance failure proves FND-CROSS-0001 remains unresolved. The finding is fixed, not verified or closed, because no current green runtime evidence or master rerun exists.
residual_risk_de: Der exakte PR-55-Head 42b31f1c84c0c915a5cb65119714613fbf3e0c40 enthält das strikte Gate und bestand CodeQL/SonarCloud, aber sein korrektes report-governance-Fehlschlagen belegt, dass FND-CROSS-0001 ungelöst bleibt. Das Finding ist fixed, nicht verified oder closed, weil keine aktuelle grüne Runtime-Evidence und kein Master-Rerun existieren.

history.detail: Governance-only success and strict runtime-evidence rejection were reproduced; the isolated Parent workflow remediation started after a pre-fix workflow-contract failure.

PR 55 wired the strict gate after governance and the focused security review found no bypass. Its expected CI rejection of stale critical inputs keeps FND-CROSS-0001 as a release blocker; no merge or master verification occurred.
